name: PlanetScale MCP
description: Connects AI agents to PlanetScale databases to inspect branches and schema, run read or write SQL, and pull query Insights, for teams on PlanetScale Vitess or Postgres.

skills.name: Branch Schema Inspection
skills.description: Lists organizations, databases, and branches, and returns the schema of a chosen database branch.

skills.name: SQL Query Execution
skills.description: Runs read-only SQL against a replica or primary, or write and DDL queries when the granted scope allows them.

skills.name: Query Insights
skills.description: Returns query performance insights and infrastructure metrics such as CPU, memory, replication lag, and connections.

skills.name: Schema Recommendations
skills.description: Lists schema recommendations such as adding or removing indexes and preventing primary key exhaustion.

skills.name: Query Error Analysis
skills.description: Groups failing queries by error fingerprint and lists the individual failed executions behind each pattern.
